description.short_caption: Gram stain showing gram-positive branching filamentous bacteria.
description.detailed_description: This is a microscopic image of a Gram stain preparation. It shows numerous gram-positive branching filamentous bacteria, which appear as dark purple structures against a lighter background. The branching morphology is characteristic of certain bacterial species. The image also contains scattered debris and other non-specific staining artifacts.
visible_findings: background with scattered debris and artifacts

description.short_caption: Skin ulcer with necrotic tissue and surrounding desquamation.
description.detailed_description: The image shows a skin ulcer with a central area of yellowish necrotic tissue surrounded by erythematous and desquamated skin. The ulcer appears irregular in shape with a moist base, and the surrounding skin shows peeling and inflammation. The lesion suggests a possible infectious or ischemic etiology.
